name: Hokuriku Electrical Construction Co.,Ltd.
summary: Hokuriku Electrical Construction Co.,Ltd. engages in the construction business in Japan. The company is involved in electrical contracting, telecommunications, ventilating and air conditioning, plumbing, firefighting facilities, pipework construction, civil engineering work, and steel structure works. It also provides businesses related to electrical, steam, and other energy. In addition, the company sells, leases, and manages real estate properties. Hokuriku Electrical Construction Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1944 and is headquartered in Toyama, Japan.
